notes:
Identity verified on four criteria against ONE official source (carehospitals.com): his own CARE doctor page URL carries name-slug 'mohammed-imran', specialty-slug 'neuro-spine-surgeon', city 'hyderabad' and branch segment 'nampally' - matching the input row's name + Neurosurgery + CARE Hospitals Nampally + Hyderabad exactly. Corroborated by his own website drimranneuro.com, whose about page independently states he is at CARE Hospitals Nampally and gives the Exhibition Grounds Road address, and by Skedoc/Lybrate/MediGence. Band is Medium not High because his own website is primary self-published (never a second official source per the banding rule) and the directories are corroborating-only; no .gov.in, university, ORCID or second-hospital official source surfaced.

CONTACT VERIFICATION. The practice line '83286 89818' came from a search summary and was exact-phrase re-checked as required: the quoted search for "8328689818" OR "83286 89818" returned his own site's contact page https://drimranneuro.com/contact-neurosurgeon and site home https://drimranneuro.com/ among the indexed results, and the summary tied the number to the CARE Hospitals Nampally Exhibition Grounds Road address. It is therefore recorded as a published practice line on his OWN page, not an aggregator line. Recorded digits-only as it was returned in two formats.

REJECTED: '+91-40-68106529' appeared in three separate summaries as 'his' booking number - it is the CARE Hospitals GROUP central switchboard and was rejected every time. ZoomInfo results were rejected twice over: contact-broker domain (barred outright) AND a masked address ('****@drimranneuro.com') which must never be completed - so professional_email is left blank even though his site plainly has a domain email. A JustDial listing ('Dr. Imran Neurosurgeon & Spine Surgeon, near Secunderabad') was rejected as a call-tracking proxy.

AMBIGUITY HANDLING - 'Mohammed Imran' is a common name and at least three other Hyderabad neuro doctors surfaced. Deliberately EXCLUDED: 'Dr. Mohammed Imran - Interventional Radiologist' at Renova NIGL Hospital (different specialty); 'Dr. Shaik Imran Ali', neurosurgeon at Zoi/Olive/Dandy (different name); and 'Dr. Muhammad Imran', neurologist in Lahore, Pakistan (different country). FLAGGED FOR HUMAN CHECK, NOT RECORDED: a Practo profile 'Dr. Mohammed Imran, Neurosurgeon, RTC X Road' (https://www.practo.com/hyderabad/doctor/mohammed-imran-2-neurosurgeon), a separate Practo 'Dr. M D Imran' entry, and a Bajaj Finserv Health listing at Srikara Hospital Secunderabad RTC Cross Roads. One summary asserted the CARE doctor also works at Srikara Hospitals Secunderabad, but the Bajaj listing describes '12-13 years' experience and a career via Mediciti and Aster Prime, which does not reconcile with CARE's '19 years' and the Gandhi Medical College MCh 2016 track. Because I could not resolve whether that is the same man with a second location or a different doctor, the practo field was left BLANK and no Srikara affiliation is asserted. Everything recorded above is tied either to the CARE Nampally page or to drimranneuro.com.
